scripts.build:technology-map: python scripts/build_company_technology_map.py --pdf "C:/Users/buy4u/Downloads/전체 기업 정보_참고용_최종.pdf" --targets data/target_companies.json --keywords config/technology_keywords.json --out-json data/company_technology_map.json --out-csv data/company_technology_map.csv
